entries.text: Channel Classics CCS SA 30910 — May 2010, St John the Evangelist, Upper Norwood; Rachel Podger with Brecon Baroque one-to-a-part; Jonathan Freeman-Attwood / C. Jared Sacks — carries BWV 1041, 1042, and reconstructions after BWV 1056 and 1055. Seed year 2009 is a year early of the sessions; BWV 1043 is not on this disc (it arrives on CCSSA34113). BBC Music called the one-to-a-part case invigorating; Presto made it Recording of the Week; BBC Radio 3 Building a Library (4 Nov 2023) named this disc the recommended recording of BWV 1041. Three stars and Référence among the assessed violin-concerto cards — for chamber HIP Bach on Channel, not for a phantom 1041–1043 triad.
